We have a private harbor on Arbuckle Lake open to swimming from May 1 - October 31. We have a floating water park consisting of trampolines slides and climbing walls. blurb: Goddard Youth Camp is 44-building camp that includes residential cabins, teaching and meeting spaces, and a large dining hall. Five maintained natural trails take visitors through a range of environments. We offer residential environmental education for public and private school groups and summer camps for churches and youth organizations.
